title: Local-First Serverless CMS
description: A Git-backed headless CMS and static site engine running on localhost with GitHub Pages delivery.

blocks.heading: Write Locally. Version in Git. Deliver Serverless.
blocks.subheading: Author long-form posts and modular landing pages entirely on your machine. Publish to GitHub Pages as both a static website and a headless JSON API with zero cloud infrastructure costs.

items.title: Air-Gapped Local Authoring
items.description: Your content stays on your machine. No cloud database lock-in, latency, or monthly hosting bills.

items.title: Git as Source of Truth
items.description: Every publish creates an immutable Git commit with automated conflict safety, staging, and audit history.

items.title: Dual-Head Static Delivery
items.description: Pre-renders accessible HTML pages and generates RESTful static JSON API endpoints for headless consumer apps.

blocks.markdown:
## How It Works

1. **Local Management Studio:** Run a lightweight React UI and Fastify daemon on `localhost`.
2. **Type-Safe Validation:** Shared Zod schemas strictly validate frontmatter and page blocks prior to every commit.
3. **Serverless CI/CD:** GitHub Actions executes static Astro builds and pre-generates the complete Headless API directory at `dist/api/`.
